meta.name: sequential-think
meta.description: Multi-step reasoning engine for complex analysis and systematic problem solving. Use when: (1) Complex debugging scenarios with multiple layers, (2) Architectural analysis and system design, (3) Problems requiring hypothesis testing and validation, (4) Multi-component failure investigation, (5) Performance bottleneck identification. Triggers: "--think", "--think-hard", "--ultrathink", "analyze step by step", "break down this problem", "systematic analysis". IMPORTANT: Do NOT use for simple single-step tasks.

copy.tagline: 把复杂问题拆成步骤逐步推理解决
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要一步步分析复杂问题或调试多层故障。
